Scenario Name: Default trigger values are displayed correctly
Objective: Confirm the system displays the new default trigger values in Finance.
Preconditions:
- The default values for the new fields are mainly applicable for newly created deals
- Rights Engineering / Rights Operations to create some set of deals for testing. Ideally mirror some existing deals identified by Finance
- A deal is accepted into Finance
- Title Valuation is available
Business Steps:
1. Open the deal in Finance
2. Navigate to Title Valuation
3. Review the displayed values for Cap Trigger and Amort Trigger
Expected Result:
- Cap Trigger default is displayed as Licence Start Date
- Amort Trigger default is displayed as First Airing

Scenario Name: Valid combination: Cap Trigger = Licence Start Date / Amort Trigger = First Airing
Objective: Validate the default business scenario for Currents and Library content.
Preconditions:
- Title is available in Finance
- Trigger fields are editable
Business Steps:
1. Set Cap Trigger to Licence Start Date
2. Set Amort Trigger to First Airing
3. Save the title
4. Attempt TV approval
5. Review Amort behaviour
Expected Result:
- Combination is accepted as valid
- TV can be approved and posted to GL
- Amort does not proceed to approval until trigger conditions are met, in line with agreed design

Scenario Name: Valid combination: Cap Trigger = Licence Start Date / Amort Trigger = Licence Start Date
Objective: Validate the edge case where no First Airing date exists and Finance switches Amort Trigger.
Preconditions:
- Title has no First Airing date available
- Deal accepted into Finance
Business Steps:
1. Set Cap Trigger to Licence Start Date
2. Set Amort Trigger to Licence Start Date
3. Save the title
4. Attempt TV approval
5. Attempt Amort approval
Expected Result:
- Combination is accepted as valid
- TV can be approved and posted
- Amort can be approved and posted

Scenario Name: Invalid combination: Cap Trigger = First Airing / Amort Trigger = Licence Start Date
Objective: Validate that the invalid business combination cannot be processed as a valid scenario.
Business Steps:
1. Set Cap Trigger to First Airing
2. Set Amort Trigger to Licence Start Date
3. Attempt to save and/or progress the deal through approval
Expected Result:
- This combination is treated as invalid
- System prevents, blocks, or otherwise does not allow this combination to progress as a valid scenario
- Ideally, we are expecting a UI error message which shout this as an invalid combination

Scenario Name: Valid combination: Cap Trigger = First Airing / Amort Trigger = First Airing
Preconditions:
- Title has a First Airing date available
- Deal accepted into Finance
Business Steps:
1. Set Cap Trigger to First Airing
2. Set Amort Trigger to First Airing
3. Save the title
4. Attempt TV approval
5. Review Amort schedule and approval state
Expected Result:
- Combination is accepted as valid
- FX basis is aligned to the Month of Premiere TX
- TV cannot be approved until First Airing date is populated
- Amort schedule is created and behaves as per agreed design

Scenario Name: FX is always based on Cap Trigger
Objective: Validate that FX for Asset Value and Amortisation follows the Cap Trigger.
Preconditions:
- Need to create 2 test deals for testing this scenario. Rights Engineering/RightsOps to create these deals
- Test data available for at least: Cap Trigger = Licence Start Date and Cap Trigger = First Airing
- Relevant FX scenario visible in Finance/reporting
Business Steps:
1. Use a scenario where Cap Trigger = Licence Start Date and capture the FX month used
2. Use a scenario where Cap Trigger = First Airing and capture the FX month used
3. Compare the FX basis in both scenarios
Expected Result:
- If Cap Trigger = Licence Start Date, FX basis = Month of Licence Start
- If Cap Trigger = First Airing, FX basis = Month of Premiere TX
- Asset Value and Amortisation follow the Cap Trigger consistently

Scenario Name: Subscriber deal: Cap Trigger can be changed in Finance
Preconditions:
- Need to create 1 subscriber test deal for testing this scenario. Rights Engineering/RightsOps to create this deal
- Subscriber deal available in Finance
- Deal accepted into Finance
Business Steps:
1. Open the Subscriber deal in Finance
2. Navigate to Title Valuation
3. Change Cap Trigger to First Airing
4. Save the deal
Expected Result: - Finance user can set Cap Trigger = First Airing for Subscriber deals

Scenario Name: Subscriber deal: Cap Trigger change does not sync back and does not reset on re-acceptance
Objective: Validate persistence of the Finance-side Cap Trigger change for Subscriber deals.
Preconditions:
- Need to create 1 test deal for testing this scenario. Rights Engineering/RightsOps to create this deal
- Subscriber deal already updated in Finance
- A Rights In change is available for re-acceptance
Business Steps:
1. Change Cap Trigger in Finance
2. Re-accept the deal into Finance after a subsequent Rights In change
3. Re-open Title Valuation
Expected Result:
- Cap Trigger changed in Finance does not reflect back to Rights In
- Cap Trigger does not reset to the original/default value on re-acceptance

Scenario Name: Title Valuation approval when Cap Trigger = First Airing and premiere date is missing
Objective: Validate title-level approval blocking when Cap Trigger depends on First Airing.
Preconditions:
- Need to create 1 test deal for testing this scenario. Rights Engineering/RightsOps to create these deals
- Cap Trigger = First Airing
- At least one title has no premiere / First Airing date
Business Steps:
1. Open Title Valuation
2. Attempt to approve all titles using title-level approval
3. Review which titles are selectable
Expected Result:
- Only titles with a premiere date can be approved
- Titles without a First Airing date are greyed out
- TV cannot be approved for titles where First Airing is missing

Scenario Name: Amort schedule is created based on Licence Start Date when First Airing is missing
Objective: Validate the agreed behaviour for unscheduled titles.
Preconditions:
- First Airing date is missing
- Trigger combination under test relies on First Airing
Business Steps:
1. Open the title in Finance
2. Review/generate the Amort schedule
3. Check the initial schedule start month
Expected Result: - Initial Amort schedule is created based on Licence Start Date when airing date is missing

Scenario Name: Amort schedule auto-adjusts when First Airing arrives later
Objective: Validate automatic schedule adjustment after First Airing becomes available.
Preconditions:
- UAT 12 scenario completed
- First Airing date becomes available later
Business Steps:
1. Re-open the title after the First Airing date is populated
2. Review the Amort schedule again
3. Compare the new schedule with the earlier version
Expected Result:
- Schedule is adjusted automatically
- Old transactions are reversed
- New transactions are generated

Scenario Name: Amort approval with Amort Trigger = First Airing
Objective: Validate Amort approval behaviour for First Airing-based scenarios.
Preconditions:
- Amort Trigger = First Airing
- Mixed-title deal with some scheduled and some unscheduled titles
Business Steps:
1. Open the deal in Finance
2. Attempt Amort approval using title-level approval
3. Review resulting title statuses and messages
Expected Result:
- Titles with airing date available can be approved
- Titles without airing date remain unapproved
- User sees message: "Some transactions cannot be approved due to a missing trigger"

Scenario Name: Deal-level Submit and Approve with missing airing date
Objective: Validate deal-level approval behaviour and user message.
Preconditions:
- At least one title has no airing date
- Deal-level approval path is used
Business Steps:
1. Open Submit and Approve
2. Search for the deal
3. Attempt to approve the deal
Expected Result:
- User sees the message: "The transactions cannot be approved; kindly approve from the View Transaction Screen"
- Only titles with an airing date can be selected
- Remaining titles are greyed out

Scenario Name: Trigger changes after TV and Amort approvals
Objective: Validate controlled handling of post-approval trigger changes.
Preconditions: - Title Valuation and Amortisation already approved
Business Steps:
1. Attempt to change Cap Trigger and/or Amort Trigger after approval
2. Follow the required corrective process
3. Re-approve TV and Amort
Expected Result:
- System requires manual reversal of transactions
- TV and Amort must be re-approved after reversal

Objective: Validate that posted transactions are not reversed on clearance revocation.
Preconditions: - TV and/or Amort already posted to GL
Business Steps:
1. Identify a posted title/deal
2. Revoke clearance
3. Review transactions

Scenario Name: Clearance revoked after approval but before posting
Objective: Validate behaviour when clearance is revoked before GL posting.
Preconditions:
- TV and/or Amort approved
- Not yet posted to GL
Business Steps:
1. Revoke clearance
2. Review title/deal state
3. Perform the required corrective process
Expected Result:
- User must manually reverse transactions
- User must approve and post again

- Impacted deals available for review
Business Steps:
1. Review corrected deals before and after patch execution
2. Compare FX basis and expected trigger logic
Expected Result: - FX outcomes are corrected in line with Cap Trigger
